quotations.old_english: On xiiii nihte mónan is gód ǽlc telge tó anginnanne

source_text: telge (?) :-- On xiiii nihte mónan is gód ǽlc telge tó anginnanne, Lchdnr, iii. 178, 31. Cockayne refers the word to telg and translates dyeing; but the passage at 190, 21, in which the same date is said to be 'eallum gód þingum gód' suggests a different meaning. The forms of the whole piece are corrupt.
